family_context.name: SV Trockener Ernst
family_context.visual_context: Vintage seaside swim club in muted coral and cream, rubber swim caps, small terry towel collars, brass goggles held clear of eyes
family_context.relationship_policy: Shared fictional sports team and distinct playing roles; no canonical pair/state/trio/combat-tier assignments
family_context.satirical_target: Competitive status, teamwork, hierarchy, certainty and neighbourly care; fictional HyperNorm sports residents

figuren.name: Franz Freistilamt

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout only; not certified crop

figuren.temperament: He treats the shortest route as a competitive moral achievement.
figuren.prompt_auszug: Franz Freistilamt, male-read. Compact forward-leaning but upright comma ink blob, gleeful focused white eyes, crooked wide open grin with two upper teeth; coral rubber cap, tiny cream towel collar; one single thick wooden kickboard tucked at flank, short goo hands ready.

bild.cell_semantics: logical layout only; not certified crop
